name: Baltimore
living: the tall ships' masts sway very gently in the harbor, their rigging lanterns twinkling warm
the little white sailboat in the Inner Harbor bobs and drifts slowly past (sprite-able)
the red-brick warehouse's arched windows light up one by one as dusk deepens, an occasional one flicking off
the flag on the ship's mast ripples lazily in the harbor breeze
light-tower lamp banks glow and softly breathe, moths and dust motes drifting through the cones
downtown tower windows flicker and the gold crown of the art-deco tower catches a slow glint
peach clouds drift slowly across the darkening sky (sky layer drift) as the first stars twinkle
the little lamps along the outfield wall pulse softly in sequence
crowd shimmer in the right-field stands, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
